what: time-boxed EXACTLY-3-SPLIT campaign vs the bulk-cycle obstruction class (s=111 and s=207)

info.qualifier: BOUNDED/PARTIAL: no realization of s=111 found via EXACTLY 3 split(s), each into <= 2 sub-parties, over 4248 distinct (pynauty-canonical) leaf-colored tree structures at n_bulk in [4, 5, 3]. Split-groups were FULLY covered at n_bulk=[] — but with a per-cell candidate CAP (max_trees=300); cells that hit it sampled only the first 300 distinct trees in enumeration order (PARTIAL, not exhaustive); the run was also TRUNCATED by the time budget before all (split,bulk) cells were reached (PARTIAL). This negative is bounded by (i) the exactly-3-split/m=2/n_bulk enumeration AND the leaf-boundary restriction of colored_trees (boundary vertices must be tree leaves), (ii) the caps just noted, and (iii) the HEURISTIC weight fit (a fit miss is not a proof the structure cannot realize v). NOT a proof that no tree realization exists; NOT a statement about realizability (the ray is holographic).

interpretation: TIME-BOXED 3-SPLIT CAMPAIGN (12.1h, gates B/C passed). NO tree found for either target -> both PARTIAL/capped bounded negatives (stop-on-success was armed but not triggered). s=111: 4248 distinct structures across 14/35 split-triples at the RESOLVING n_bulk=4 (rays 10/17 resolve there), capped 300/cell, no tree. s=207: only 398 structures across ~1.3/35 triples -- coverage CRIPPLED by rare EXTREME-cost fits (root-caused: one n_bulk=4 structure churned the LP for 460s; the cut_rounds cap bounds cut_rounds but not the descents loop on a pathological weighted graph). Neither reached full coverage; the searched region is a SMALL fraction of the full 3-split space. NOT a proof no tree exists; 111/207 holographic; only the exactly-3-split tree question is bounded here. Both negatives come from a fit VALIDATED (GATE B, a=4) to recover rays 10/17 known 3-split trees -> not toothless.

fit_pathology_207.finding: s=207 3-split fits average ~10x s=111 due to RARE extreme-cost structures (e.g. one = 460s); these ate 207 6h budget -> ~1.3/35 triples vs 111 14/35.
fit_pathology_207.fix: per-fit wall-clock timeout (fit_timeout) — a timeout == a fit miss == bounded-honest. VALIDATED: fit_timeout=3 skips the 460s churner (logged as fit_timeouts) and 207 then runs at 111 rate; GATE B still passes (known trees fit <1s). Held uncommitted; a re-run with it would lift 207 to ~14 triples.
